changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK','RETRACT_FEEDBACK','SLACK_POST')); -- The reply to a Slack turn of the last day that no server settled. A server took one that has a state: Slack may show -- it, so it is looked for in the history and never sent again. One that no server took is sent. The reply that a -- server took for a turn that still runs waits for the turn's end, which makes it due; the end of a running turn that -- nobody took creates its reply then. -- A taken reply of an ended turn may already be in Slack, also at the top level: it becomes an attempt whose write -- started and whose lease ended, so the next attempt reads the history and never posts it again. INSERT INTO agent_action (id, workspace_id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, subject_account_id, attempts, max_attempts, lease_epoch, leased_until, write_started_at, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), e.workspace_id, 'SLACK_POST', 'slack_reply:' || e.id, 'slack_reply:' || e.id, CASE WHEN r.fenced THEN 'EXECUTING' ELSE 'ADMITTED' END, jsonb_build_object('entryId', e.id, 'turnId', e.turn_id, 'taken', e.slack_delivery IS NOT NULL), c.account_id, CASE WHEN r.fenced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 3, CASE WHEN r.fenced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN r.fenced THEN clock_timestamp() END, CASE WHEN r.fenced THEN clock_timestamp() END, CASE WHEN r.ended THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE clock_timestamp() + interval '1 day' END, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM mentor_entry e JOIN mentor_turn t ON t.id = e.turn_id AND t.workspace_id = e.workspace_id JOIN mentor_conversation c ON c.id = e.conversation_id AND c.workspace_id = e.workspace_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.status IN ('DONE', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED') AND t.leased_until IS NULL AS ended) d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT d.ended, d.ended AND e.slack_delivery IS NOT NULL AS fenced) r WHERE e.kind = 'USER' AND e.surface = 'SLACK' AND (e.slack_delivery IS NULL OR e.slack_delivery IN ('PENDING', 'UNCERTAIN')) AND ((t.status IN ('DONE', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED') AND t.finished_at >= clock_timestamp() - interval '1 day') OR (t.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED') AND e.slack_delivery IS NOT NULL)); -- A weekly digest's note that a server took and did not settle: looked for in the history, never sent again. INSERT INTO agent_action (id, workspace_id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, subject_account_id, attempts, max_attempts, lease_epoch, leased_until, write_started_at, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), e.workspace_id, 'SLACK_POST', 'slack_digest:' || e.id, 'slack_digest:' || e.id, 'EXECUTING', jsonb_build_object('entryId', e.id, 'turnId', NULL, 'taken', TRUE), c.account_id, 1, 3, 1, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM mentor_entry e JOIN mentor_conversation c ON c.id = e.conversation_id AND c.workspace_id = e.workspace_id WHERE e.kind = 'DIGEST' AND e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.slack_delivery IN ('PENDING', 'UNCERTAIN') AND e.created_at >= clock_timestamp() - interval '1 day'; -- The entry keeps only how its post ended: a post that the outbox now carries has no outcome yet. An older -- unsettled post keeps its last state. UPDATE mentor_entry e SET slack_delivery = NULL WHERE e.slack_delivery IN ('PENDING', 'UNCERTAIN') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_action a WHERE a.workspace_id = e.workspace_id AND a.idempotency_key IN ('slack_reply:' || e.id, 'slack_digest:' || e.id)); DROP INDEX ix_mentor_entry_digest_unsettled; DROP INDEX ix_mentor_entry_slack_question_unsettled; ALTER TABLE mentor_entry DROP COLUMN slack_attempts;
